data.rationale: The proposal follows the same procedure in the same order (converter, holidays, email with the correct subject and body templates), but it has small errors. It says "Calendar > Holidays" where the true menu is Holidays. It ties the holiday country to city B instead of a separate {country} parameter. It says "Send or discard" where the true workflow must Discard and never Send. It also adds a recipient parameter and hardcodes "ahead" in the body. These errors make it only partly automatable from the spec alone.
